conventions.anchor: normalised [ax, ay] of the full untrimmed frame = world origin = footprint centre (items: [0.5, 0.86] of 72 x 72 = the ground contact).
conventions.points: every *Point(s) value is a px offset [dx, dy] from the anchor (unscaled); *Dir(s) = facing of a character standing there (SW / W / NW = flipped SE / E / NE frames).  Points inside the office include the raised floor (floorLiftPx); seat points (deskPoints, chiefDeskPoint, seatPoints) are the seat FRONT-CENTRE at 0.45 m (the sit anims anchor there; the desk top is 0.72 m).
conventions.cutaway: chief_office_* layers share frameSize + anchor with chief_office (place them all at the building anchor; trimmed in the atlas).  Depth of a layer = building depth (anchor y) + depthOffsets[sprite]; draw in drawOrder.  Characters in pointSlots "behind" go to @behind (bandDepth.behind), "front" to @front; sort actors inside a band by their own y (band + y * 1e-6); "outside" = normal y-sort with the frontTest rule.  Closed look = _shell (the closed building incl. the outdoor props and its ground shadow; `chief_office` points at it) + _props (+ _glow at night).
conventions.overlays: Animated parts, aligned to the building frame (trimmed).  stove + safe (on _interior furniture) at depthOffset -0.25 as the contract says.  The desk-top overlays (typewriter_a/_b, phone, lamp_a/_b) are PATCHES (object + the desk top under its whole motion) drawn right after _interior_front at -0.08: a desk-top object stands in front of everyone in @behind (a clerk at the filing cabinet, a seated clerk's arm), so at -0.25 those people would cover it.  _interior_front has a hole where the frame-0 object is, so the patches also look right if a renderer keeps all overlays at -0.25.
conventions.outsideActors: An actor / prop outside the walls is IN FRONT of the building when, with (x, y) = its point minus the building anchor, y - x / 2 > frontTest.a (in front of the -Y face) or y + x / 2 > frontTest.b (right of the +X face).  Its depth is then max(its world y, building depth + top) (+ y * 1e-6), top = the depth of the building's top-most layer + 0.01: 0.02 with depthOffsets (_props +0.01), 0.01 x cutaway.drawOrder.length with src/entities/Cutaway.js indices.  So the mailbox and an actor walking along the facade behind it keep their y order.  Everything else around the building is behind it (plain world y).
conventions.collision: wallCircles = [dx, dy, r] at ground level (r in the Collision metric dx^2 + (2 dy)^2, 64 per metre) along the four walls with a gap at the door; an inside actor (drawn floorLiftPx higher) tests its point + [0, floorLiftPx].  walkPoly = the inside floor the chief / staff may walk on (lifted like the inside points), with a notch through the door.
conventions.night: chief_office.night: _glow is NORMAL-blend artwork over the closed shell at night (DayClock lightsOn), NEVER by day and never while revealed; lightPoints for dayClock.addLight (lightPointsOpen while revealed).  The inside layers are not dimmed by us (the DayClock MULTIPLY overlay does that).
conventions.insideShadows: People inside the office stand on the raised floor: draw their contact shadow at building depth + cutaway.insideShadowDepthOffset (-0.449, just above _floor) and floorLiftPx up; at DEPTH.SHADOW it would sit under _floor and vanish.
conventions.furniture: chief_office.furnitureM = the inside furniture footprints in building metres ([x0, y0, x1, y1], top height) - for walk avoidance; standing work spots keep >= 0.3 m from every tall piece.
conventions.items: 72 x 72 frames, anchor [0.5, 0.86] (36, 61.9) = bottom centre of the ground contact; stackStep px between stacked copies; carryScale for head-carried stacks; icon true (usable as UI icons).
conventions.shadows: the building, its layers and the mailbox have baked soft cool shadows falling screen down-right; items none.

reveal.notes: Reveal (the chief within revealPx of doorPoint, an office panel open, the 관망 camera, or a tap inside revealPoly) tweens closed -> open in fadeMs: _shell to openAlpha 0.12 and _shell_cut in (alpha = 1 - shell alpha, scaled; it also carries the open-building ground shadow).  open is the contract state (CONTRACT_V42 AI.1 reveal.states closed / open) - earlier builds called it `cut` (alias kept).  bare = no front walls and no stubs (shell 0): close-ups and screenshots only - it has no ground shadow.  (The old `half` peek, shell 0.45 over the whole inside, read as a muddy double exposure and was dropped.)  Inside layers + inside staff exist only while revealed; the closed look is _shell (which already holds the outdoor props and the closed ground shadow) + _props (+ _glow at night).

cut.visible: only while revealed (fade in with the shell fade out)

chief_office.deskBandsNote: Per desk band (overrides pointSlots.deskPoints): 총총이 (secretary desk) and 딸랑이 (counting table) sit in band front - their desks render with _shell_cut, because another desk stands behind their heads on screen (desk 1 behind 총총이, the chief's desk behind 딸랑이) and the one-layer _interior_front would cover their heads.  셈이, 소복이 and the chief: band behind.

boardRect.note: The blank slate of the 재고판 chalkboard (back wall, runs along world X): draw the 5 stock bars inside widthPx x heightPx centred on point, sheared y += 0.5 * x (x = px right of point).  Only while revealed (it is part of _back).

signRect.note: The blank cream sign board over the door (part of _shell; nothing is baked).  Write the name centred on point, fitted into widthPx x heightPx, sheared y += 0.5 * x, alpha = the shell alpha; HIDE it while the shell alpha is below hideBelowShellAlpha (revealed: the text would float at 12 % over the inside left wall).  The shear recipe (a canvas texture drawn with setTransform(1, 0.5, 0, 1, ...)) is in tools/test/office_phaser.mjs shearText().

cutaway.nightRule: draw night[] at building depth + 0.005 (NORMAL blend) only while closed (reveal alpha < 0.02) and dayClock.lightsOn; feed chief_office.night.lightPoints to dayClock.addLight (lightPointsOpen while revealed)

cut.visible: only while revealed (fade in with the shell fade out); it also carries the open-building ground shadow

cutaway.notes: Cutaway.js reads layers.interior / .back / .front (inside while closed), fade.layer, cut.layer and drawOrder (depth base + 0.01 * index; slotDepth for @behind / @front).  Closed by day it draws exactly the documented closed look (_shell + _props; off_check simulates it).  An inside person's contact shadow belongs at building depth + insideShadowDepthOffset (just above _floor), not at DEPTH.SHADOW (under _floor, invisible).

night.noteOpen: While revealed at night feed lightPointsOpen (the three desk lamps, the stove fire, the door lantern) to dayClock.addLight instead: the inside reads warm and lamp-lit.
night.note: NORMAL-blend artwork drawn over the closed shell (bright warm panes + halos).  Also feed lightPoints to dayClock.addLight for the warm ground halo (beach_bld convention); the glow may instead go to the DayClock light layer (DEPTH.FX - 29) for an even stronger night look.

chief_office.notes: 촌장 사무실 (chief office, 5.6 x 4.4 m): a cosy one-storey timber-and-plaster office - warm cream plaster between honey timber posts and belts on a pale stone plinth, a snowy teal gable roof (the town hall family) with a pinecone finial and a brick chimney, tall white windows with little red curtains, a teal double door with brass knobs under a fan light, a blank cream sign board over the door (the game writes 촌장 사무실 into signRect), a lantern post by the steps.  CUTAWAY (bank / logistics layer contract): _floor (floorboards, rugs, the chief's round dais), _back (wallpaper + wainscot, chalkboard, village map with pins, cork notice board, pigeonhole mail shelf, window, clock, key board, town emblem), _interior (chairs, pot-belly stove + kettle, filing cabinet, the hollow iron safe on its plinth + coin sacks, coat rack, visitor bench, plants), _interior_front (the chief's desk, the two clerk desks), _shell_cut (wall stubs at 1.2 m + sills + short door jambs, the secretary desk + the counting table - their sitters sit in band front, see deskBands - the plinth fringe and the open-building ground shadow), _shell (the closed building incl. its ground shadow and the outdoor props), _glow (night window light + lantern halo, drawn only while closed at night), _props (steps, lantern post).

pageSplit.note: office_bld is ONE page (CONTRACT_V42 AI.1; tools/test/chief2_phaser.mjs and of_preview.py load it alone), so the closed office keeps its inside resident.  For the plan 13.2 plaza budget (office closed look 2.5 MiB, officeInside acquired only by a reveal) split it at build time like town_civic: tools/build/pack_pages.py TOWN_SPLIT['office_bld'] = [('closed', set(closed)), ('inside', None)] -> office_bld@closed (always) + office_bld@inside (Residency region officeInside).  The two pages cost +2 shipped files.

chief_office_floor.notes: Floorboards, rugs, the chief's dais, the inside door mat.  No ground shadow (polish H1): it has no pixel outside the opaque closed shell, so a renderer that draws it always (src/entities/Cutaway.js) keeps the closed look exact.

chief_office_interior_front.notes: Clerk desks 1 and 2 and the chief's desk (they hide the legs of the people seated behind them, band behind).  The secretary desk and the counting table are in _shell_cut.

chief_office_shell_cut.notes: Dollhouse wall stubs at 1.2 m, sills, the door jambs at stub height, the two desks nearest the camera (the secretary desk, the counting table: their sitters are in band front, see deskBands), the plinth's outer fringe + the open-building ground shadow (it shows exactly while revealed, alpha = reveal, like logistics _shadow_open).

chief_office_shell.notes: The closed building in one frame (walls, roof, sign board, door, windows + the outdoor props + its own ground shadow).  `chief_office` points at this frame.

chief_office_glow.notes: Night: warm window light + door-lantern halo over the closed shell.

chief_office_stove.notes: Fire flicker in the pot-belly stove window (loop). The kettle steam / chimney smoke are game FX (fxPoints.kettle / .chimney).

chief_office_safe.notes: The courier's safe door: frame 0 shut, frame 1 open (coins + a gold bar inside). anims.open / close.

chief_office_typewriter_a.notes: 셈이's typewriter (desk 1): keys hop, the carriage nudges; frame 0 = still. Play anims.type while she types (officefolk desk_type). PATCH: the frame holds the object AND the desk top it moves over, so it composites exactly drawn right after _interior_front (depthOffset -0.08).

chief_office_lamp_a.notes: 셈이's desk lamp: frame 0 warm (normal), frame 1 red shade = shortage alert (states.alert). PATCH: the frame holds the object AND the desk top it moves over, so it composites exactly drawn right after _interior_front (depthOffset -0.08).

chief_office_lamp_b.notes: 소복이's desk lamp: frame 0 warm, frame 1 red (spare alert, e.g. an unanswered letter). PATCH: the frame holds the object AND the desk top it moves over, so it composites exactly drawn right after _interior_front (depthOffset -0.08).

chief_office_typewriter_b.notes: 소복이's typewriter (desk 2), same anim. PATCH: the frame holds the object AND the desk top it moves over, so it composites exactly drawn right after _interior_front (depthOffset -0.08).

chief_office_phone.notes: The telephone on desk 2: frame 1 = the receiver jumps on its cradle (ringing); anims.ring alternates. PATCH: the frame holds the object AND the desk top it moves over, so it composites exactly drawn right after _interior_front (depthOffset -0.08).

office_mailbox.notes: Red post mailbox (1.1 m, footprint 0.4 m) outside the office: a rounded red box with a pinecone emblem on its +X side and a sunny yellow flag on a gold arm, a cream door with the letter slot on the front (-Y), snow on top, on a timber post with a snowy foot.  anims.flag 2 f (0 down: the flag lies along the box side below the snow cap; 1 up: it stands clear above the cap), anims.pop 3 f @ 12 fps (the flag springs up past vertical, wobbles back and settles up).  slotPoint = where letters fly in.  Placed at chief_office.outdoorProps[0].point; y-sort it like a town prop.

item_coin_sack_s.notes: Small coin sack: burlap tied with red string, a gold coin emblem, coins peeking out.

item_coin_sack_m.notes: Medium coin sack (the same sack, fuller).

item_coin_sack_l.notes: Large coin sack, bulging with coins, a few spilled coins at its foot.

item_letter_bundle.notes: Bundle of 5 envelopes (cream, pink, blue) tied with a red string bow, a red heart seal on top.

item_newspaper_bundle.notes: Folded newspapers (grey column lines, no text) tied with twine.

item_ledger.notes: Thick green ledger with gold corners and a red ribbon bookmark.
